name: agent-with-tool-budget
description: An agentic loop with a hard turn cap (max_turns, clamped [1,32], default 8) + a hard cost ceiling (max_cost_usd) — the loop terminates as Incomplete with stop_reason=budget_exhausted BEFORE starting a turn that would breach it. The runaway-repeat detector trips on RUNAWAY_REPEAT_THRESHOLD consecutive byte-identical steps (the fastest agent-spend leak — it catches a stuck loop before a static cost cap). Use this template as the cost-controlled base for any agent-with-tools workflow.

nodes.prompt: You are a coding assistant. Use the provided tools to read files + answer the question concisely. Question: {{input.text}}
